line.sv: Tack själv. Nästa gång får du välja ett nytt äventyr.
line.lit: Thanks yourself. Next time get you choose a new adventure.
line.en: Thank you too. Next time you can choose a new adventure.

line.sv: Det är lördag. Du och din fru står i köket och planerar dagen.
line.lit: It is Saturday. You and your wife stand in kitchen-the and plan day-the.
line.en: It is Saturday. You and your wife are in the kitchen planning the day.

line.sv: Du väljer utflykt i dag. Jag hjälper dig med svenskan, men du får prata.
line.lit: You choose outing today. I help you with Swedish-the, but you get speak.
line.en: You choose today's outing. I'll help with Swedish, but you do the talking.

line.sv: Det är åtta grader och det ska regna i eftermiddag.
line.lit: It is eight degrees and it shall rain this afternoon.
line.en: It is eight degrees and it is going to rain this afternoon.

question.sv: Vad behöver du ta på dig?
question.lit: What need you put on yourself?
question.en: What do you need to wear?

say.sv: Jag tar en tröja och en regnjacka.
say.lit: I take a jumper and a rain-jacket.
say.en: I'll wear a jumper and a rain jacket.

reply.sv: Bra. Svenskt väder uppskattar en reservplan.
reply.lit: Good. Swedish weather appreciates a backup-plan.
reply.en: Good. Swedish weather appreciates a backup plan.

say.sv: Jag tar en tunn skjorta. Det är väl varmt?
say.lit: I take a thin shirt. It is surely warm?
say.en: I'll wear a thin shirt. It's warm, isn't it?

reply.sv: Åtta grader. Värmen verkar ha tagit ledigt.
reply.lit: Eight degrees. Warmth-the seems to have taken time off.
reply.en: Eight degrees. The warmth seems to have taken the day off.

say.sv: Jag behöver ingen jacka. Jag går fort.
say.lit: I need no jacket. I go fast.
say.en: I don't need a jacket. I'll walk fast.

reply.sv: Regnet går också ganska fort.
reply.lit: Rain-the goes also fairly fast.
reply.en: The rain moves fairly quickly too.

say.sv: Jag tar på mig ett paraply.
say.lit: I put on myself an umbrella.
say.en: I'll put on an umbrella.

reply.sv: Du kan ta med ett paraply. Att ta på sig det blir ett annat äventyr.
reply.lit: You can take along an umbrella. To put on oneself it becomes another adventure.
reply.en: You can bring an umbrella. Wearing it would be another adventure.

line.sv: Det är lördag morgon. Din telefon blinkar ilsket rött på tre procent eftersom laddaren inte satt i väggen ordentligt i natt.
line.lit: It is Saturday morning. Your phone flashes angrily red on three percent because charger-the sat not in wall-the properly last-night.
line.en: It is Saturday morning. Your phone is flashing angry red at three percent because the charger wasn't pushed all the way into the wall socket overnight.

line.sv: Du sköter svenskan i dag, och jag tänker inte vara din mänskliga karta när din skärm slocknar om fyra minuter.
line.lit: You handle Swedish-the today, and I intend not be your human map when your screen goes-out in four minutes.
line.en: You're doing the Swedish talking today, and I refuse to act as your human GPS when your screen dies in four minutes.

question.sv: Hur räddar du telefonen innan vi sätter igång med lördagen?
question.lit: How save you phone-the before we set going with Saturday-the?
question.en: How do you rescue your phone before we start our Saturday?

say.sv: Jag tar med powerbanken och stoppar ner rätt laddsladd i fickan.
say.lit: I take along powerbank-the and tuck down right charging-cord in pocket-the.
say.en: I'll bring the power bank and put the right charging cable in my pocket.

reply.sv: Klokt. Utan batteri fungerar varken tågbiljetter, inköpslista eller ditt lokalsinne.
reply.lit: Wise. Without battery work neither train-tickets, shopping-list nor your sense-of-direction.
reply.en: Smart move. Without battery, neither train tickets, shopping lists, nor your sense of direction work.

say.sv: Jag lägger telefonen i mikrovågsugnen i tio sekunder så laddas den snabbt.
say.lit: I lay phone-the in microwave-oven-the in ten seconds so charges it fast.
say.en: I'll pop the phone in the microwave for ten seconds for a quick charge.

reply.sv: Det enda du laddar på det viset är brandvarnaren.
reply.lit: The only-thing you charge in that way-the is smoke-alarm-the.
reply.en: The only thing you'll charge that way is the smoke alarm.

say.sv: Jag skriver ut hela internet på papper innan vi går.
say.lit: I print out whole internet on paper before we go.
say.en: I'll print out the entire internet on paper before we leave.

reply.sv: Skrivaren har slut på gult bläck, som vanligt.
reply.lit: Printer-the has out of yellow ink, as usual.
reply.en: The printer is out of yellow ink, naturally.

say.sv: Tre procent räcker lätt till måndag om jag blundar när jag tittar på skärmen.
say.lit: Three percent suffices easily until Monday if I shut-eyes when I look on screen-the.
say.en: Three percent will easily last till Monday if I squint at the screen.

reply.sv: Din telefon drar fyra procent bara av att visa klockan.
reply.lit: Your phone draws four percent just from to show clock-the.
reply.en: Your phone burns four percent just displaying the time.

line.sv: Du har precis dragit på dig en nytvättad ljus tröja när morgonkaffet bestämmer sig för att hoppa ur muggen rakt på bröstet.
line.lit: You have just pulled on yourself a newly-washed light jumper when morning-coffee-the decides itself for to jump out-of mug-the straight onto chest-the.
line.en: You've just pulled on a freshly washed light-coloured jumper when your morning coffee decides to leap out of the mug straight onto your chest.

line.sv: Nytt personligt rekord! Fyrtiotvå sekunder i en ren tröja. Du får sköta snacket i dag ändå.
line.lit: New personal record! Forty-two seconds in a clean jumper. You get handle chat-the today anyway.
line.en: New personal best! Forty-two seconds in a clean jumper. You're still doing the talking today.

question.sv: Vad gör du åt kaffefläcken?
question.lit: What do you about coffee-stain-the?
question.en: What are you going to do about the coffee stain?

say.sv: Jag sköljer fläcken i kallt vatten direkt och byter till en mörk tröja.
say.lit: I rinse stain-the in cold water directly and change to a dark jumper.
say.en: I'll rinse the stain in cold water right away and change into a dark jumper.

reply.sv: Mörk tröja är din naturliga skyddsfärg före lunch.
reply.lit: Dark jumper is your natural camouflage-colour before lunch.
reply.en: Dark knitwear is your natural protective camouflage before noon.

say.sv: Jag häller kaffe över resten av tröjan så den blir jämnt brun.
say.lit: I pour coffee over rest-the of jumper-the so it becomes evenly brown.
say.en: I'll pour coffee over the rest of the jumper so it's an even shade of brown.

reply.sv: Kreativt, men du kommer lukta som golvet på ett stationskafé.
reply.lit: Creative, but you will smell like floor-the at a station-café.
reply.en: Creative, though you'll smell like the floor of a train-station café.

say.sv: Jag vänder tröjan bak och fram så fläcken hamnar på ryggen.
say.lit: I turn jumper-the back and front so stain-the ends-up on back-the.
say.en: I'll wear the jumper backwards so the stain is on my back.

reply.sv: Då kvävs du av halslinningen innan vi ens når hallen.
reply.lit: Then choke you from neckline-the before we even reach hallway-the.
reply.en: Then the neckline will strangle you before we even reach the hall.

say.sv: Jag klipper bort ett runt hål i tröjan där fläcken sitter.
say.lit: I cut away a round hole in jumper-the where stain-the sits.
say.en: I'll cut a neat hole out of the front of the jumper where the stain is.

reply.sv: Lägg ner saxen och öppna garderoben i stället.
reply.lit: Lay down scissors-the and open wardrobe-the instead.
reply.en: Step away from the scissors and open the wardrobe instead.

line.sv: Genom köksfönstret strålar klarblå himmel och solsken, men björkarna utanför böjer sig dubbelvikta i en iskall nordvind.
line.lit: Through kitchen-window-the beams clear-blue sky and sunshine, but birches-the outside bend themselves double-folded in an ice-cold north-wind.
line.en: Through the kitchen window the sky is dazzling blue and sunny, yet the birch trees outside are bent sideways in an icy north wind.

line.sv: Klassiskt svenskt lurendrejeri. Det ser ut som juli inifrån köket, men termometern står på tre grader. Och i dag pratar du svenska.
line.lit: Classic Swedish trickery. It looks out like July from-inside kitchen-the, but thermometer-the stands on three degrees. And today speak you Swedish.
line.en: Classic Swedish weather deception. Looks like July from inside the kitchen, while the thermometer says three degrees. And today you're speaking Swedish.

question.sv: Vad tar du på dig när vädret försöker lura dig?
question.lit: What put you on yourself when weather-the tries trick you?
question.en: What do you put on when the weather tries to fool you?

say.sv: Jag tar vindtät jacka, halsduk och solglasögon i fickan.
say.lit: I take windproof jacket, scarf and sunglasses in pocket-the.
say.en: I'll wear a windproof jacket and a scarf, with sunglasses in my pocket.

reply.sv: Perfekt. Då slipper jag höra att dina öron håller på att ramla av om tjugo minuter.
reply.lit: Perfect. Then escape I hear that your ears hold on to fall off in twenty minutes.
reply.en: Perfect. That saves me from hearing that your ears are falling off twenty minutes from now.

say.sv: Shorts och sandaler — solen värmer ju genom glaset!
say.lit: Shorts and sandals — sun-the warms after-all through glass-the!
say.en: Shorts and sandals — the sun feels warm right through the glass!

reply.sv: Ja, därför att vi har fönsterrutor och element inomhus.
reply.lit: Yes, because that we have window-panes and radiators indoors.
reply.en: Yes, because we have double glazing and central heating indoors.

say.sv: Jag tar med ett element under armen.
say.lit: I take along a radiator under arm-the.
say.en: I'll carry a radiator under my arm.

reply.sv: Förlängningssladden räcker tyvärr bara till brevlådan.
reply.lit: Extension-cord-the reaches unfortunately only to letterbox-the.
reply.en: Sadly the extension lead only reaches as far as the postbox.

say.sv: Jag lindar in mig i aluminiumfolie mot vinden.
say.lit: I wrap in myself in aluminium-foil against wind-the.
say.en: I'll wrap myself in tin foil against the wind.

reply.sv: Du ska ut bland folk, inte bakas i ugnen i hundraåttio grader.
reply.lit: You shall out among people, not be-baked in oven-the in hundred-eighty degrees.
reply.en: You're going out in public, not into the oven at 180 degrees.

line.sv: Klockan har passerat nio och ingen av er har ätit frukost än. Erfarenheten visar att lågt blodsocker är farligare än spöregn.
line.lit: Clock-the has passed nine and neither of you has eaten breakfast yet. Experience-the shows that low blood-sugar is more-dangerous than pouring-rain.
line.en: It's past nine and neither of you has had breakfast yet. Experience has shown that low blood sugar is deadlier than horizontal rain.

line.sv: Går vi igång med dagen utan mat i magen kommer vi gräla om vägvalet redan i trappan. Dessutom är det din tur att öva svenska i dag.
line.lit: Go we going with day-the without food in stomach-the will we quarrel about route-choice-the already on stairs-the. Besides is it your turn to practise Swedish today.
line.en: If we start the day on an empty stomach we'll be arguing before we hit the bottom of the stairs. Plus it's your turn to practise Swedish today.

question.sv: Hur förebygger du ett blodsockerfall?
question.lit: How prevent you a blood-sugar-drop?
question.en: How do you prevent a hangry meltdown?

say.sv: Jag brer varsin rejäl ostmacka på knäckebröd innan vi bestämmer resten.
say.lit: I spread one-each proper cheese-sandwich on crispbread before we decide rest-the.
say.en: I'll make us each a proper cheese crispbread sandwich before we decide anything else.

reply.sv: Räddaren i nöden. Nu tål mitt tålamod nästan vad som helst.
reply.lit: Saviour-the in distress-the. Now tolerates my patience almost what as preferably.
reply.en: Lifesaver. Now my patience can withstand almost anything.

say.sv: Jag dricker fyra espresso i rad i stället för mat.
say.lit: I drink four espressos in row instead for food.
say.en: I'll down four straight espressos instead of eating.

reply.sv: Då kommer du darra som en torktumlare och fortfarande vara hungrig.
reply.lit: Then will you vibrate like a tumble-dryer and still be hungry.
reply.en: Then you'll vibrate like a spin cycle and still be starving.

say.sv: Jag tuggar på ett tuggummi från förra vintern.
say.lit: I chew on a chewing-gum from last winter-the.
say.en: I'll chew on a stick of gum I found from last winter.

reply.sv: Mintsmak från januari räknas inte som frukost.
reply.lit: Mint-flavour from January counts not as breakfast.
reply.en: January lint-flavoured mint does not count as a meal.

say.sv: Vi äter frukost på måndag när vi har bättre tid.
say.lit: We eat breakfast on Monday when we have better time.
say.en: Let's postpone breakfast until Monday when we're less busy.

reply.sv: Jag överlever inte ens till klockan elva utan ost.
reply.lit: I survive not even until clock eleven without cheese.
reply.en: I won't even survive till eleven a.m. without cheese.

title.en: Did we turn off the coffee maker?

line.sv: Ni är precis på väg ut ur köket när den klassiska helgpaniken slår till som en blixt från klar himmel.
line.lit: You-two are just on way out of kitchen-the when the classic weekend-panic-the strikes to like a lightning from clear sky.
line.en: You are just stepping out of the kitchen when the classic weekend paranoia strikes out of nowhere.

line.sv: Vänta lite nu. Lyser den röda knappen på kaffebryggaren fortfarande, eller inbillar jag mig?
line.lit: Wait a-little now. Glows the red button-the on coffee-maker-the still, or imagine I myself?
line.en: Hold on a second. Is the red switch on the coffee maker still glowing, or am I imagining things?

question.sv: Vad kollar du så vi slipper oroa oss hela dagen?
question.lit: What check you so we escape worry ourselves whole day-the?
question.en: What do you check so we don't spend all day worrying?

say.sv: Jag stänger av kaffebryggaren, drar ur sladden och kollar att spisen är av.
say.lit: I switch off coffee-maker-the, pull out cord-the and check that stove-the is off.
say.en: I switch off the coffee maker, pull the plug, and double-check every dial on the hob.

reply.sv: Skönt! Ta ett foto på den utdragna sladden också om du vill ha total sinnesro.
reply.lit: Relieving! Take a photo on the pulled-out cord-the too if you want have total peace-of-mind.
reply.en: What a relief! Take a photo of the unplugged cord too if you want total peace of mind.

say.sv: Den stänger säkert av sig själv någon gång under hösten.
say.lit: It switches surely off itself sometime during autumn-the.
say.en: I'm sure it turns itself off eventually sometime this autumn.

reply.sv: Vår bryggare är äldre än vår relation. Den stänger aldrig av sig frivilligt.
reply.lit: Our coffee-maker is older than our relationship. It switches never off itself voluntarily.
reply.en: Our coffee maker is older than our relationship. It never surrenders voluntarily.

say.sv: Jag ringer grannen och ber dem lukta vid brevinkastet varje timme.
say.lit: I phone neighbour-the and ask them smell by letterbox-the every hour.
say.en: I'll call the neighbour and ask them to sniff our letterbox every hour.

reply.sv: Det går nog liiite fortare att ta tre steg tillbaka till bänken.
reply.lit: It goes probably a-liiiittle faster to take three steps back to counter-the.
reply.en: Walking three steps back to the counter might be slightly quicker.

say.sv: Vi häller vatten över eluttaget så inget kan börja brinna.
say.lit: We pour water over power-socket-the so nothing can begin burn.
say.en: Let's splash water on the wall socket so nothing can catch fire.

reply.sv: Snälla, rör inga vätskor nära väggkontakten!
reply.lit: Please, touch no liquids near wall-socket-the!
reply.en: Please keep all liquids far away from the mains electricity!

line.sv: Du kliver rakt in i badrummet i strumplästen och trampar mitt i en kall vattenpöl framför duschen.
line.lit: You step straight into bathroom-the in stocking-feet and tread mid in a cold water-puddle in-front-of shower-the.
line.en: You pad into the bathroom in your socks and step dead-centre into a cold puddle left outside the shower.

line.sv: Dessutom har du en randig strumpa och en prickig strumpa på dig. Bra start på en lördag där du ska prata svenska med folk!
line.lit: Besides have you one striped sock and one polka-dot sock on yourself. Good start on a Saturday where you shall speak Swedish with people!
line.en: On top of that, you're wearing one striped sock and one polka-dot sock. Strong start to a Saturday where you're speaking Swedish in public!

question.sv: Hur löser du fotläget?
question.lit: How solve you foot-situation-the?
question.en: How do you sort out the foot situation?

say.sv: Jag torkar upp pölen på golvet och hämtar ett torrt, matchande par strumpor.
say.lit: I wipe up puddle-the on floor-the and fetch a dry, matching pair socks.
say.en: I wipe up the puddle on the tiles and grab a dry, matching pair of socks.

reply.sv: Två likadana torra strumpor! Nu känner jag mig genast tryggare.
reply.lit: Two identical dry socks! Now feel I myself immediately safer.
reply.en: Two matching dry socks! Suddenly I have faith in today.

say.sv: Jag trär en plastpåse utanpå den blöta strumpan i skon.
say.lit: I thread a plastic-bag on-outside-of the wet sock-the in shoe-the.
say.en: I'll slip a freezer bag over the wet sock inside my shoe.

reply.sv: Jag vägrar gå bredvid någon som prasslar och skvalpar vid varje steg.
reply.lit: I refuse walk beside someone who rustles and sloshes at every step.
reply.en: I refuse to walk beside someone who crinkles and sloshes with every step.

say.sv: Jag torkar strumpan på foten med brödrosten.
say.lit: I dry sock-the on foot-the with toaster-the.
say.en: I'll dry the sock right on my foot using the toaster.

reply.sv: Vår brödrost har strikt förbud mot fötter.
reply.lit: Our toaster has strict ban against feet.
reply.en: Our toaster has a strict zero-foot policy.

say.sv: Jag hoppar på ett ben hela lördagen så märks det inte.
say.lit: I hop on one leg whole Saturday-the so is-noticed it not.
say.en: I'll just hop on my dry foot all Saturday so nobody notices.

reply.sv: Det kommer definitivt märkas, särskilt i trapporna.
reply.lit: It will definitely be-noticed, especially on stairs-the.
reply.en: People will definitely notice, especially on the stairs.

line.sv: Din fru öppnar köksskåpet där sju vattenflaskor och nitton udda plastlock rasar ut över bänken.
line.lit: Your wife opens kitchen-cupboard-the where seven water-bottles and nineteen odd plastic-lids avalanche out over counter-the.
line.en: Your wife opens the kitchen cupboard, unleashing seven water bottles and nineteen orphaned plastic lids across the worktop.

line.sv: Det är alltid bra att ha vatten redo på en lördag. Och glöm inte att jag bara viskar glosor i dag — du står för svenskan.
line.lit: It is always good to have water ready on a Saturday. And forget not that I only whisper vocabulary-words today — you stand for Swedish-the.
line.en: Having water handy on a Saturday never hurts. And remember, I'm only whispering vocabulary hints today — you're doing the talking.

question.sv: Hur vinner du kampen mot flaskskåpet?
question.lit: How win you battle-the against bottle-cupboard-the?
question.en: How do you win the battle of the bottle cupboard?

say.sv: Jag hittar ett tätt lock, fyller flaskan med kallt kranvatten och skruvar åt ordentligt.
say.lit: I find a tight lid, fill bottle-the with cold tap-water and screw tight properly.
say.en: I find a lid that actually seals, fill the bottle with cold tap water, and screw it shut tight.

reply.sv: Skaka den upp och ner över vasken först! Ja, den höll tätt. Mirakel.
reply.lit: Shake it up and down over sink-the first! Yes, it held tight. Miracle.
reply.en: Test it upside down over the sink first! Hey, zero leaks. It's a miracle.

say.sv: Jag häller kranvatten direkt i jackfickan så slipper vi lock.
say.lit: I pour tap-water directly in jacket-pocket-the so escape we lids.
say.en: I'll pour tap water straight into my coat pocket so we don't need a lid.

reply.sv: Din regnjacka är vattentät utifrån, inte en termos inifrån.
reply.lit: Your rain-jacket is waterproof from-outside, not a thermos from-inside.
reply.en: Your rain jacket is waterproof on the outside, not a thermos on the inside.

say.sv: Jag tar med alla nitton locken i en påse och ingen flaska.
say.lit: I take along all nineteen lids-the in a bag and no bottle.
say.en: I'll pack all nineteen lids in a bag and zero bottles.

reply.sv: Väldigt skramligt och väldigt lite att dricka.
reply.lit: Very rattly and very little to drink.
reply.en: Very noisy, and remarkably unhelpful when you get thirsty.

say.sv: Jag tejpar igen flaskhalsen med maskeringstejp.
say.lit: I tape shut bottle-neck-the with masking-tape.
say.en: I'll seal the top of the bottle with masking tape.

reply.sv: Förra gången du provade det badade din mobil i ryggsäcken.
reply.lit: Last time-the you tried that bathed your mobile in backpack-the.
reply.en: Last time you tried DIY bottle engineering, your phone went swimming in the backpack.

line.sv: Jackan är på, men nyckelskålen är tom.
line.lit: Jacket-the is on, but key-bowl-the is empty.
line.en: Your jacket is on, but the key bowl is empty.

line.sv: Känn efter i fickan på jackan du hade i går.
line.lit: Feel around in pocket-the on jacket-the you had yesterday.
line.en: Check the pocket of the jacket you wore yesterday.

question.sv: Var är nycklarna?
question.lit: Where are keys-the?
question.en: Where are the keys?

say.sv: Här är de! De ligger i jackfickan.
say.lit: Here are they! They lie in jacket-pocket-the.
say.en: Here they are! They're in the jacket pocket.

reply.sv: Precis. Nycklar brukar trivas där man lämnade dem.
reply.lit: Exactly. Keys tend to thrive where one left them.
reply.en: Exactly. Keys tend to like being where you left them.

say.sv: De ligger säkert i skålen. Vi går nu.
say.lit: They lie surely in bowl-the. We go now.
say.en: They're surely in the bowl. Let's go now.

reply.sv: Skålen är tom. Den har redan blivit förhörd.
reply.lit: Bowl-the is empty. It has already been interrogated.
reply.en: The bowl is empty. It's already been questioned.

say.sv: Vi behöver inga nycklar när vi går ut.
say.lit: We need no keys when we go out.
say.en: We don't need keys when we go out.

reply.sv: Det stämmer. Det är när vi ska in igen som det blir intressant.
reply.lit: That is correct. It is when we shall in again that it becomes interesting.
reply.en: True. It gets interesting when we want to come back in.

say.sv: Jag letar i kylskåpet först.
say.lit: I look in refrigerator-the first.
say.en: I'll look in the fridge first.

reply.sv: Gör det. Fråga mjölken om den har sett något.
reply.lit: Do that. Ask milk-the if it has seen anything.
reply.en: Go ahead. Ask the milk whether it has seen anything.

line.sv: I hallen böjer du dig ner, drar åt högerskon — och klack! Halva skosnöret går rakt av i näven på dig.
line.lit: In hallway-the bend you yourself down, pull tight right-shoe-the — and snap! Half shoelace-the goes straight off in fist-the on you.
line.en: In the hallway you bend down, pull your right shoelace tight — and SNAP! Half the lace comes away in your fist.

line.sv: Jag lovar att skosnören kan lukta sig till när man precis är klar i hallen.
line.lit: I promise that shoelaces can smell themselves to when one just is ready in hallway-the.
line.en: I swear shoelaces can sense the exact moment you're ready in the hallway.

question.sv: Hur löser du skokrisen utan att tappa humöret?
question.lit: How solve you shoe-crisis-the without to lose temper-the?
question.en: How do you solve the footwear crisis without losing your rag?

say.sv: Jag byter snabbt till det andra paret skor på skohyllan.
say.lit: I change quickly to the other pair-the shoes on shoe-rack-the.
say.en: I quickly swap into my other pair of shoes from the shoe rack.

reply.sv: Smidigt! Och vi skriver upp nya skosnören innan vi glömmer det.
reply.lit: Smooth! And we write up new shoelaces before we forget it.
reply.en: Smooth recovery! And let's note down new shoelaces before we forget.

say.sv: Jag knyter fast skon med spagetti från skafferiet.
say.lit: I tie fast shoe-the with spaghetti from pantry-the.
say.en: I'll tie my shoe with uncooked spaghetti from the pantry.

reply.sv: Okokt spagetti har usel knutstyrka och kokt är ännu värre.
reply.lit: Uncooked spaghetti has terrible knot-strength and cooked is even worse.
reply.en: Uncooked spaghetti snaps on the first step, and cooked spaghetti is worse.

say.sv: Jag går i bara en sko och en toffel.
say.lit: I go in only one shoe and one slipper.
say.en: I'll wear one shoe and one fluffy indoor slipper.

reply.sv: Du kommer gå i cirklar som en halt anka.
reply.lit: You will walk in circles like a limping duck.
reply.en: You'll end up walking in circles like a lopsided duck.

say.sv: Jag häftar fast skon i strumpan med häftapparaten.
say.lit: I staple fast shoe-the in sock-the with stapler-the.
say.en: I'll staple the shoe directly onto my sock.

reply.sv: Inga kontorsmaterial i fötterna på en lördag, tack.
reply.lit: No office-supplies in feet-the on a Saturday, thanks.

question.en: What do you say now that you've been caught red-handed?

say.en: Fair enough — I'll nip out to the bin room and drop the bag off right now!

reply.en: Thank you! Another minute in the warm hall and that bag would have walked out on its own.

say.en: Oh, is that rubbish? I genuinely thought we'd bought a minimalist beanbag.

reply.en: Rubbish wearing a beanie is still rubbish.

reply.en: Sadly, Gösta has been evicted effective immediately.

line.en: Is your card holder still sitting next to your laptop from when you ordered screws last night?

question.en: What do you do before we choose our Saturday plan?

title.en: The mystery of the missing glasses

line.sv: Du lyfter på vantar, tidningar och mössor på hallbyrån på jakt efter dina glasögon medan din fru ser road ut.

line.en: You're turning over gloves, newspapers, and beanies on the hall table hunting for your glasses while your wife watches in silent amusement.

line.en: Would you like a clue in Swedish, or are you planning to dismantle the shoe rack too?

question.en: Where are your glasses actually hiding?

reply.en: In that case, the magpie built its nest right on top of your hair.

say.sv: Jag tar med teaterkikaren från bokhyllan i stället.
say.lit: I take along opera-glasses-the from bookshelf-the instead.
say.en: I'll bring a pair of brass binoculars instead.

reply.lit: We own no opera-glasses. Feel after above eyebrows-the.

title.en: The zip that ate your jumper

line.en: You yank your jacket zip up in one brisk motion and the slider mercilessly chews into your jumper halfway up.

line.sv: Andas lugnt. Sliter du till nu har du varken hel jacka eller hel tröja kvar.
line.lit: Breathe calmly. Yank you to now have you neither whole jacket nor whole jumper left.
line.en: Breathe. Rip at it like a caveman and you'll ruin both the jacket and the jumper.

question.sv: Hur tar du dig ur fällan?
question.lit: How take you yourself out-of trap-the?
question.en: How do you free yourself?

say.en: I ease the caught fabric sideways and gently work the slider back down.

reply.sv: Kirurgisk precision! Både du och garderoben överlevde.

reply.en: Surgical precision! Both you and your clothes live to see another Saturday.

say.sv: Jag sliter upp jackan med ett vrål som en actionhjälte!

say.en: I rip the jacket apart with a primal roar like an action hero!

reply.lit: Action-heroes have clothing-budget from film-studio-the, that have not we.

say.sv: Jag smörjer in hela bröstet med smör från kylen.
say.lit: I grease in whole chest-the with butter from fridge-the.
say.en: I'll rub salted butter from the fridge all over the zip.

reply.sv: Bregott hör hemma på mackan, inte på ytterplagg.

say.sv: Jag får helt enkelt bo i den här jackan fram till midsommar.

reply.sv: Det blir varmt i duschen. Kom hit så håller jag i kanten.

question.sv: Vad gör du innan vi bestämmer dagens plan?
question.lit: What do you before we decide day-the's plan?
question.en: What do you do before we settle on today's plan?

say.en: I'll board up the living room doorway with timber.

reply.sv: Handtaget på balkongdörren kräver betydligt färre spikar.

reply.en: Turning the handle on the balcony door requires significantly fewer nails.

line.en: You just grabbed the mangled little one, didn't you? We've only kept that wreck for two years out of pure forgetfulness.

question.en: What do you do with the umbrellas?

reply.sv: Akta taklampan och mina ögon! Vänta tills vi är utomhus om det regnar.

reply.en: Mind the ceiling light and my eyes! Save that for outdoors if it rains.

title.en: The dinosaur guarding the laundry room

line.sv: Nere i källaren vaktas tvättstugan av en brutal elektronisk bokningspanel från kritaperioden. En repig grå plåtlåda med stenhårda knappar och en kornig liten LCD-skärm räknar kallblodigt ner sekunderna.
line.lit: Down in basement-the is-guarded laundry-room-the by a brutal electronic booking-panel from Cretaceous-period-the. A scratched grey sheet-metal-box with rock-hard buttons and a grainy little LCD-screen counts cold-bloodedly down seconds-the.
line.en: Down in the basement, the shared laundry is guarded by a brutal electronic booking terminal from the Cretaceous period. A scarred grey metal box with rock-hard buttons and a crude, grainy LCD screen is coldly counting down the seconds.

line.sv: Kommer man en kvarts sekund för sent raderar det här monstret hela bokningen, och vid passets slut klipper den strömmen mitt i centrifugeringen. Till och med dinosaurierna hade skämts över den här skärmen.
line.lit: Comes one a quarter's second too late erases this here monster-the whole booking-the, and at slot-the's end cuts it power-the mid in spin-cycle-the. Even dinosaurs-the had been-ashamed over this here screen-the.
line.en: Show up a quarter-second late and this monster deletes your entire booking, and the instant your slot ends it cuts the power mid-spin. Even dinosaurs would have been embarrassed by this LCD screen.

question.sv: Den flimrande skärmen piper och visar LÄGG BRICKA MOT LÄSARE — 01 MIN KVAR. Vad gör du?
question.lit: The flickering screen-the beeps and shows LAY TAG AGAINST READER — 01 MIN LEFT. What do you?
question.en: The flickering LCD beeps and flashes PLACE TAG ON READER — 01 MIN LEFT. What do you do?

say.sv: Jag trycker plastbrickan hårt mot läsaren och knappar in vårt lägenhetsnummer innan tiden går ut.
say.lit: I press plastic-tag-the hard against reader-the and key in our flat-number before time-the goes out.
say.en: I press the plastic tag firmly against the reader and punch in our flat number before the timer expires.

reply.sv: KLONK! Det lät som en medeltida fängelseport, men vi besegrade maskinen med tjugo sekunders marginal.
reply.lit: CLUNK! It sounded like a medieval prison-gate, but we defeated machine-the with twenty seconds' margin.
reply.en: CLUNK! That sounded like a medieval dungeon gate, but we beat the machine with twenty seconds to spare.

say.sv: Jag bankar på plåtlådan och skriker sesam öppna dig.
say.lit: I bang on sheet-metal-box-the and shout sesame open yourself.
say.en: I bang on the metal box and yell open sesame.

reply.sv: Den här reliken förstår varken sagor eller mänsklig nåd. Använd brickan!
reply.lit: This here relic-the understands neither fairy-tales nor human mercy. Use tag-the!
reply.en: This relic understands neither fairy tales nor human mercy. Use the tag!

say.sv: Jag försöker svepa på den korniga LCD-skärmen som en pekskärm.
say.lit: I try swipe on the grainy LCD-screen-the like a touchscreen.
say.en: I try swiping the grainy LCD screen like an iPad.

reply.sv: Det enda du får av att dra fingret över den där plastbiten är statisk elektricitet och krossade drömmar.
reply.lit: The only-thing you get from to drag finger-the over that there plastic-piece-the is static electricity and crushed dreams.
reply.en: All you'll get from swiping that piece of plastic is static electricity and crushed dreams.

say.sv: Vi väntar en minut och ser om den startar om sig själv.
say.lit: We wait one minute and see if it restarts about itself.
say.en: Let's wait a minute and see if it reboots itself.

reply.sv: Om en minut går vår tvättid upp i rök och grannen på trean tar den med ett hånleende!
reply.lit: In one minute goes our laundry-time up in smoke and neighbour-the on third-floor-the takes it with a smirk!
reply.en: In one minute our laundry slot vanishes into thin air and the third-floor neighbour steals it with a smirk!

title.en: Welcome to our shared laundry room!

line.sv: På väggen hänger en skinande skylt: Välkommen till vår gemensamma tvättstuga! Där står att alla fickor ska tömmas på småsaker, att BH med byglar ska ligga i tvättpåsar och att tre fjärdedelar full maskin är lagom.
line.lit: On wall-the hangs a shiny sign: Welcome to our shared laundry-room! There stands that all pockets shall be-emptied of small-things, that bra with underwires shall lie in wash-bags and that three quarters full machine is just-right.
line.en: On the wall hangs a glossy placard: 'Welcome to our shared laundry room!' It decrees that all pockets must be emptied, underwire bras must go into wash bags, and filling the drum 3/4 full is 'lagom'.

line.sv: Och titta, längst ner under Att tänka på står det faktiskt Lämna ditt husdjur hemma. Vem har försökt centrifugera en tax här nere?!
line.lit: And look, farthest down under To think on stands it actually Leave your pet at-home. Who has tried spin-dry a dachshund here down?!
line.en: And look, at the bottom under 'Things to keep in mind' it literally says 'Leave your pet at home.' Who tried to spin-dry a dachshund down here?!

question.sv: Du försöker trycka in hela berget på en gång — hur fyller du maskinen enligt skylten?
question.lit: You try shove in whole mountain-the at one time — how fill you machine-the according-to sign-the?
question.en: You're trying to cram the entire pile into one drum — how do you load the machine according to the sign?

say.lit: I empty all pockets, lay underwire-bra-the in wash-bag-the and fill drum-the to three quarters.
say.en: I empty every pocket, put the underwire bra in a mesh wash bag, and fill the drum three-quarters full.

reply.sv: Titta, du kan ju läsa svenska myndighetstexter när du anstränger dig.
reply.lit: Look, you can after-all read Swedish authority-texts when you exert yourself.
reply.en: Look at that, you really can read bureaucratic Swedish signage when you put your mind to it.

say.sv: Jag pressar in lakanen med knät så vi slipper köra två maskiner.
say.lit: I press in sheets-the with knee-the so we escape run two machines.
say.en: I'll ram the sheets in with my knee so we don't have to run two loads.

reply.sv: Tre fjärdedelar är lagom, står det! Pressar du hårdare kommer trumman ut på gården.
reply.lit: Three quarters is just-right, stands it! Press you harder comes drum-the out onto courtyard-the.
reply.en: The sign says three-quarters is lagom! Push any harder and the drum will launch into the courtyard.

say.sv: Jag slänger in dörrmattan, blekmedel och behån löst i samma trumma.
say.lit: I toss in doormat-the, bleach and bra-the loose in same drum.
say.en: I'll chuck the muddy doormat, bleach, and the loose underwire bra into the same drum.

reply.sv: Grattis, du lyckades precis bryta mot fyra punkter på skylten i en enda mening.
reply.lit: Congratulations, you succeeded just break against four points on sign-the in one single sentence.
reply.en: Congratulations, you just managed to violate four separate bullet points on the sign in a single sentence.

say.lit: I fetch neighbour-the's cat so we can test pet-rule-the.
say.en: I'll go borrow the neighbour's cat so we can test the pet rule.

reply.sv: Rör inte katten och rör inte mina sidenblusar.
reply.lit: Touch not cat-the and touch not my silk-blouses.
reply.en: Leave the cat alone and step away from my silk blouses.

title.en: The washing placard and the blue pixel menu

line.sv: Tvättmaskinen har ett stort vred och en kantig blå LCD-skärm. På skylten Tvättanvisning står det: Välj program genom att vrida på vredet, dosera tvättmedel i rätt fack och starta med tryck på vredet.
line.lit: Washing-machine-the has a big dial and a blocky blue LCD-screen. On sign-the Washing-instruction stands it: Choose programme through to turn on dial-the, dose detergent in right compartment and start with press on dial-the.
line.en: The Electrolux washer sports a chunky rotary dial and a blocky blue LCD screen. The 'Tvättanvisning' placard reads: 'Select programme by turning the dial, dose detergent properly, and start by pressing the dial.'

line.sv: Maskinen skriver stolt Vägning av tvätt startar..... och går in i NORMAL 40 — HUVUDTVÄTT. Exakt då ser du en ensam svart strumpa på golvet och trycker på vredet. En pixlig ruta poppar upp: TRYCK FÖR VAL: TILLBAKA / PAUS / ÄNDRA PROGRAM / AVSLUTA PROGRAM.
line.lit: Machine-the writes proudly Weighing of laundry starts..... and goes into NORMAL 40 — MAIN-WASH. Exactly then see you a lonely black sock on floor-the and press on dial-the. A pixelated box pops up: PRESS FOR CHOICE: BACK / PAUSE / CHANGE PROGRAMME / END PROGRAMME.
line.en: The machine proudly displays 'Weighing of laundry starting.....' and begins NORMAL 40 — HUVUDTVÄTT. Right then you spot a lone black sock on the floor and press the dial. A pixelated box pops up: 'TRYCK FÖR VAL: TILLBAKA / PAUS / ÄNDRA PROGRAM / AVSLUTA PROGRAM.'

question.sv: PAUS är markerat med vita pixlar på den blå skärmen. Hur räddar du strumpan utan katastrof?
question.lit: PAUSE is highlighted with white pixels on the blue screen-the. How save you sock-the without catastrophe?
question.en: PAUS is highlighted in white pixels on the blue screen. How do you rescue the sock without disaster?

say.sv: Jag trycker en gång till på vredet för att pausa, väntar tills luckan släpper, slänger in strumpan och trycker igen.
say.lit: I press one time more on dial-the for to pause, wait until door-hatch-the releases, toss in sock-the and press again.
say.en: I press the dial once more to pause, wait until the door unlocks, toss the sock in, and press the dial again.

reply.sv: Vetenskapligt utprovat i laboratorietester, precis som det står i det finstilta på skylten.
reply.lit: Scientifically tested-out in laboratory-tests, just like it stands in the fine-print-the on sign-the.
reply.en: 'Scientifically proven in laboratory tests,' just like the fine print on the sign claims.

say.sv: Jag vrider ner till AVSLUTA PROGRAM och börjar om från noll.
say.lit: I turn down to END PROGRAMME and begin over from zero.
say.en: I scroll down to AVSLUTA PROGRAM and start the whole wash over from scratch.

reply.sv: Då tömmer den ju ut allt tvättmedel rakt i avloppet! Vår bokningstid räcker inte till dina experiment.
reply.lit: Then drains it after-all out all detergent straight into drain-the! Our booking-time suffices not to your experiments.
reply.en: That drains all the detergent straight down the sewer! Our time slot isn't long enough for your experiments.

say.sv: Jag häller sköljmedel i förtvättsfacket och sliter i handtaget.
say.lit: I pour fabric-softener in pre-wash-compartment-the and yank in handle-the.
say.en: I pour fabric softener into the pre-wash slot and yank on the door handle.

reply.sv: Släpp handtaget innan det går av! Blomman är sköljmedel och två streck är huvudtvätt.
reply.lit: Release handle-the before it goes off! Flower-the is fabric-softener and two lines are main-wash.
reply.en: Let go of that handle before it snaps! The flower icon is softener and the two bars are main wash.

say.sv: Jag trycker på gubben som springer på panelen bredvid skärmen.
say.lit: I press on little-man-the who runs on panel-the beside screen-the.
say.en: I mash the little running-man button next to the screen.

reply.sv: Den springande gubben betyder Snabbtvätt för lätt smutsade kläder, inte nödöppning!
reply.lit: The running little-man-the means Quick-wash for lightly soiled clothes, not emergency-opening!
reply.en: The running man icon means Quick Wash for lightly soiled clothes, not emergency door release!

title.en: The tumble dryer's blue LCD riddle

line.sv: Första tvätten ska in i den enorma torktumlaren. Dess pyttelilla blå skärm lyser ilsket: YLLE — TRYCK PÅ KNAPP FÖR ATT VÄLJA TID. Bredvid skärmen sitter bara två pilknappar upp och ner.
line.lit: First laundry-the shall into the enormous tumble-dryer-the. Its tiny-little blue screen glows angrily: WOOL — PRESS ON BUTTON FOR TO CHOOSE TIME. Beside screen-the sit only two arrow-buttons up and down.
line.en: The first load goes into the hulking industrial tumble dryer. Its tiny blue LCD glares at you: 'YLLE — TRYCK PÅ KNAPP FÖR ATT VÄLJA TID.' Beside the screen sit two lone up/down arrow buttons.

line.sv: Kolla skylten Torktumling! Kör inte lakanen på YLLE och öppna absolut inte luckan under torkningen, för då blir inget torrt innan elen bryts.
line.lit: Check sign-the Tumble-drying! Run not sheets-the on WOOL and open absolutely not door-hatch-the during drying-the, for then becomes nothing dry before electricity-the is-cut.
line.en: Check the 'Torktumling' sign! Don't run cotton sheets on WOOL, and do NOT open the door mid-cycle or nothing will dry before the power cuts out.

question.sv: Du bläddrar fram LÅG TEMP — TORKAR INSTÄLLD TID på displayen. Vad gör du nu?
question.lit: You scroll forth LOW TEMP — DRIES SET TIME on display-the. What do you now?
question.en: You scroll to 'LÅG TEMP — TORKAR INSTÄLLD TID' on the LCD. What do you do now?

say.sv: Jag ställer in torktiden med pilknapparna, trycker på startknappen och låter luckan vara stängd.
say.lit: I set in drying-time-the with arrow-buttons-the, press on start-button-the and let door-hatch-the be closed.
say.en: I set the drying time with the up/down arrows, press start, and leave the door strictly shut.

reply.sv: Äntligen. Kom nu, vi har fyrtiofem minuter på oss att dammsuga och moppa lägenheten medan trumman snurrar.
reply.lit: Finally. Come now, we have forty-five minutes on us to vacuum and mop flat-the while drum-the spins.
reply.en: Finally. Come on, we've got forty-five minutes to vacuum and mop the flat while the drum spins.

say.sv: Jag väljer programmet Mikrofibermoppar till alla våra skjortor.
say.lit: I choose programme-the Microfibre-mops for all our shirts.
say.en: I select the 'Microfibre mops' programme for all our dress shirts.

reply.sv: Ser dina skjortor ut som golvmoppar? Fast svara inte på det förresten.
reply.lit: Look your shirts out like floor-mops? Though answer not on that by-the-way.
reply.en: Do your shirts look like floor mops to you? Actually, don't answer that.

say.sv: Jag öppnar luckan var tredje minut för att känna om handdukarna har torkat.
say.lit: I open door-hatch-the every third minute for to feel if towels-the have dried.
say.en: I'll open the door every three minutes to feel whether the towels are dry yet.

reply.sv: Det står med fetstil på skylten: Om Du öppnar luckan under torkningen tar det längre tid innan allt blir torrt!
reply.lit: It stands with bold-print on sign-the: If You open hatch-the during drying-the takes it longer time before everything becomes dry!
reply.en: It's literally in bold on the sign: 'If you open the door during drying, it takes longer for everything to dry!'

say.sv: Vi lämnar tvätten i tumlaren till i kväll så sköter anti-skrynklingsfunktionen resten.
say.lit: We leave laundry-the in dryer-the until tonight so handles anti-crease-function-the rest-the.
say.en: Let's leave the laundry in the dryer till tonight and let the anti-crease function handle it.

reply.sv: Lämnar vi en enda strumpa efter vår tid hänger grannen upp oss i torkskåpet.
reply.lit: Leave we one single sock after our time hangs neighbour-the up us in drying-cabinet-the.
reply.en: If we leave one sock past our slot, the next neighbour will hang us up in the drying cabinet.

alt.sv: Fastighetsskötaren kikar in
alt.lit: Caretaker-the peeks in
alt.en: The building caretaker pops in

alt.sv: Snabb kontroll i tvättstugan
alt.lit: Quick check in laundry-room-the
alt.en: Quick maintenance check

alt.sv: Tjena! Jag har tio hus till att hinna med före lunch — visade torktumlaren DAGS FÖR UNDERHÅLL på blå displayen eller rullar den som den ska?
alt.lit: Hiya! I have ten buildings more to manage before lunch — showed tumble-dryer-the TIME FOR MAINTENANCE on blue display-the or rolls it as it shall?
alt.en: Hiya! I've got ten more blocks to check before lunch — did the dryer flash 'DAGS FÖR UNDERHÅLL' on the blue LCD or is it running fine?

alt.sv: Hej, ursäkta att jag har bråttom — luktar avloppet vid golvbrunnen okej här inne efter att vi spolade stammarna?
alt.lit: Hi, excuse that I have hurry — smells drain-the by floor-drain-the okay here inside after that we flushed pipes-the?
alt.en: Hi, sorry I'm on the clock — is the floor drain running clear down here since we flushed the pipes?

alt.sv: Förlåt att jag stör mitt i tvätten, jag måste vidare till pannrummet direkt — fungerar bokningslåset utan att kärva i dag?
alt.lit: Forgive that I disturb mid in laundry-the, I must onward to boiler-room-the directly — works booking-lock-the without to jam today?
alt.en: Sorry to barge in, I'm rushing to the boiler room — did the electronic door lock open without jamming today?

alt.sv: Din fru viskar lugnt att du inte behöver låtsas hänga med när någon pratar i hundra nittio.
alt.lit: Your wife whispers calmly that you not need pretend keep up when someone speaks in hundred ninety.
alt.en: Your wife quietly whispers that you don't have to pretend you understood when someone speaks at a hundred miles an hour.

alt.sv: Din fru ger dig en uppmuntrande blick: var ärlig med din nivå och fråga om de har tid eller bråttom.
alt.lit: Your wife gives you an encouraging glance: be honest with your level and ask if they have time or hurry.
alt.en: Your wife gives you an encouraging nod: just be upfront about your Swedish and ask whether they have time or are in a rush.

alt.sv: Bredvid dig ler din fru och väntar tålmodigt på att du ska ta ordet själv.
alt.lit: Beside you smiles your wife and waits patiently on that you shall take word-the yourself.
alt.en: Beside you, your wife smiles and waits patiently for you to handle the explanation yourself.

alt.sv: Din fru puffar lätt på din arm: säg som det är, folk uppskattar när man frågar om de har bråttom.
alt.lit: Your wife nudges lightly on your arm: say as it is, people appreciate when one asks if they have hurry.
alt.en: Your wife nudges your arm gently: tell them straight — people appreciate being asked whether they're in a rush.

alt.sv: Hur förklarar du att din svenska är dålig men att du gärna övar om det inte är bråttom?
alt.lit: How explain you that your Swedish is poor but that you gladly practise if it not is hurry?
alt.en: How do you explain that your Swedish is poor, that you need to practise if they aren't rushed, or offer English if they are?

alt.sv: Vad säger du för att förvarna om svenskan och höra om det finns tid eller om engelska går snabbare?
alt.lit: What say you for to forewarn about Swedish-the and hear if there exists time or if English goes faster?
alt.en: What do you say to warn them about your Swedish and check whether there's time to practise or if English will be faster?

alt.sv: Hur ber du om att få öva svenska — med en nödutgång till engelska om personen har bråttom?
alt.lit: How ask you about to get practise Swedish — with an emergency-exit to English if person-the has hurry?
alt.en: How do you ask to practise your Swedish while offering a quick switch to English if they're in a hurry?

alt.sv: Nu gick det undan! Hur sätter du förväntningarna på svenskan på ett artigt sätt?
alt.lit: Now went it fast! How set you expectations-the on Swedish-the in a polite way?
alt.en: That came out fast! How do you politely explain your Swedish level and give them the choice?

alt.sv: Ursäkta, min svenska är väldigt dålig än. Jag behöver öva om du inte har bråttom, men har du bråttom och kan engelska går det snabbare.
alt.lit: Excuse-me, my Swedish is very poor still. I need practise if you not have hurry, but have you hurry and know English goes it faster.
alt.en: Sorry, my Swedish is still very poor. I need to practise if you're not in a hurry, though if you are and speak English that'll be faster.

alt.sv: Förlåt, jag pratar väldigt knackig svenska. Om du har tid tränar jag gärna, men har du bråttom går det fortare på engelska om du kan det.
alt.lit: Forgive, I speak very bumpy Swedish. If you have time train I gladly, but have you hurry goes it faster in English if you know it.
alt.en: Sorry, my Swedish is really shaky. If you have time I'd love to practise, though if you're in a rush English will be quicker if you speak it.

alt.sv: Min svenska är tyvärr rätt usel fortfarande. Jag måste öva om det inte är stressigt, annars kan vi ta engelska om du har bråttom.
alt.lit: My Swedish is unfortunately rather awful still. I must practise if it not is stressful, otherwise can we take English if you have hurry.
alt.en: My Swedish is still pretty awful, I'm afraid. I need to practise if you aren't rushed; otherwise we can use English if you're in a hurry.

alt.sv: Ursäkta om det går långsamt, jag kan väldigt lite svenska än. Har du inte bråttom försöker jag gärna, men på engelska går det snabbare om du har ont om tid.
alt.lit: Excuse-me if it goes slowly, I know very little Swedish still. Have you not hurry try I gladly, but in English goes it faster if you have short of time.
alt.en: Sorry if I'm slow — I know very little Swedish yet. If you're not in a hurry I'd like to try, though English will be faster if you're short on time.

alt.sv: Förlåt, min svenska är inte alls bra än. Jag behöver mängdträning om du har tid, men har du bråttom och pratar engelska byter vi direkt.
alt.lit: Forgive, my Swedish is not at-all good still. I need volume-training if you have time, but have you hurry and speak English switch we directly.
alt.en: Sorry, my Swedish isn't good at all yet. I need the practice if you have time, though if you're in a hurry and speak English we can switch right away.

alt.sv: Tack för att du frågar så snällt! Jag är faktiskt lite sen, så vi tar engelska snabbt nu — men bra jobbat med svenskan!
alt.lit: Thanks for that you ask so kindly! I am actually a-little late, so we take English quickly now — but well worked with Swedish-the!
alt.en: Thanks so much for asking! I'm actually running late, so let's do quick English right now — great job starting in Swedish though!

alt.sv: Vad omtänksamt! Jag har tyvärr jättebråttom precis nu så engelska räddar mig, men fortsätt öva — man förstod dig direkt!
alt.lit: How considerate! I have unfortunately super-hurry right now so English saves me, but continue practise — one understood you directly!
alt.en: How considerate of you! I'm in a mad rush right this second so English saves me, but keep practising — I understood every word!

alt.sv: Det är lite kö bakom oss så vi tar det snabbt på engelska den här gången, men modigt att du provade på svenska först!
alt.lit: It is a-little queue behind us so we take it quickly in English this here time-the, but brave that you tried in Swedish first!
alt.en: There's a bit of a queue behind us so let's do quick English this time, though good on you for starting in Swedish!

alt.sv: Jag har bara en minut på mig så engelska går toppen just nu — men nästa gång tar vi det på svenska!
alt.lit: I have only one minute on me so English goes top right now — but next time take we it in Swedish!
alt.en: I've only got a minute to spare so English is spot-on right now — next time we'll do it in Swedish!

alt.sv: Jag nickar febrilt och säger ja absolut till precis allt!
alt.lit: I nod feverishly and say yes absolutely to exact everything!
alt.en: I nod frantically and say 'Yes, absolutely!' to everything!

alt.sv: Jag ler stort och svarar jajemän utan att ha fattat ett enda ord.
alt.lit: I smile big and answer yeppers without to have grasped one single word.
alt.en: I beam widely and say 'You bet!' without having understood a single word.

alt.sv: Grattis, jag tror du precis lovade att passa en främlings hund hela julen.
alt.lit: Congratulations, I think you just promised to mind a stranger's dog whole Christmas-the.
alt.en: Congratulations, I'm pretty sure you just agreed to dog-sit for a stranger over Christmas.

alt.sv: Farlig strategi! Man kan inte säga jajemän till öppna frågor i Sverige.
alt.lit: Dangerous strategy! One can not say yeppers to open questions in Sweden.
alt.en: Dangerous tactic! You can't answer 'You bet!' to an either/or question in Sweden.

alt.sv: Jag fryser till is som en trädgårdstomte och stirrar rakt fram.
alt.lit: I freeze to ice like a garden-gnome and stare straight ahead.
alt.en: I freeze solid like a garden gnome and stare into the middle distance.

alt.sv: Jag står blickstilla och hoppas att jag smälter in i bakgrunden.
alt.lit: I stand dead-still and hope that I blend into background-the.
alt.en: I stand completely motionless and hope I blend into the scenery.

alt.sv: Blinka åtminstone så stackaren inte ringer ambulans!
alt.lit: Blink at-least so poor-person-the not phones ambulance!
alt.en: At least blink so the poor person doesn't call an ambulance!

alt.sv: Du har en knallfärgad jacka på dig, du är tyvärr inte osynlig.
alt.lit: You have a bright-coloured jacket on yourself, you are unfortunately not invisible.
alt.en: You're wearing a coat, not an invisibility cloak. Use your words!

alt.sv: Jag börjar prata jättehögt på engelska utan att fråga först.
alt.lit: I begin speak super-loudly in English without to ask first.
alt.en: I immediately start speaking English at double volume without asking first.

alt.sv: Jag ropar DO YOU SPEAK ENGLISH rakt ut i luften.
alt.lit: I shout DO YOU SPEAK ENGLISH straight out into air-the.
alt.en: I blurt out 'DO YOU SPEAK ENGLISH?!' at top volume.

alt.sv: Hela poängen i dag är ju att börja på svenska och fråga snällt!
alt.lit: Whole point-the today is after-all to begin in Swedish and ask kindly!
alt.en: The whole point today is starting politely in Swedish and giving them the option!

alt.sv: Sänk volymen och ta förklaringen på svenska först — du kan ju den!
alt.lit: Lower volume-the and take explanation-the in Swedish first — you know after-all it!
alt.en: Indoor voice, love — deliver your Swedish opener first, you've got this!

alt.sv: Glömd strumpa från förra passet
alt.lit: Forgotten sock from previous slot-the
alt.en: A lost sock from the previous slot

alt.sv: Lugn granne i tvättstugan
alt.lit: Calm neighbour in laundry-room-the
alt.en: An unhurried neighbour drops by

alt.sv: Ursäkta att jag knackar på! Jag tvättade i morse och undrar om det låg kvar ett rutigt örngott ovanpå torkskåpet?
alt.lit: Excuse that I knock on! I washed this morning and wonder if there lay remaining a checked pillowcase on-top-of drying-cabinet-the?
alt.en: Sorry to knock! I had the early slot this morning — did I leave a checked pillowcase on top of the drying cabinet?

alt.lit: Hi! No stress at-all, I have whole Saturday-the free — I wanted just check if next free time on board-the was on Tuesday?
alt.en: Hello! No rush at all, I've got all Saturday free — just checking whether Tuesday morning was still open on the booking board?

alt.lit: Hi neighbour! There stood a new unopened bottle green-soap in cleaning-cupboard-the, surely is it shared for everybody who cleans floor-the?
alt.en: Hi neighbour! Spotted an unopened bottle of pine soap in the cupboard — is that the communal one for mopping up?

alt.en: Your wife gives you an encouraging nod: just be upfront about your Swedish and ask whether they have time or are in a rush.

alt.lit: Your wife nudges lightly on your arm: say as it is, people appreciate when one asks if they have hurry.

alt.en: How do you explain that your Swedish is poor, that you need to practise if they aren't rushed, or offer English if they are?

alt.lit: How ask you about to get practise Swedish — with an emergency-exit to English if person-the has hurry?
alt.en: How do you ask to practise your Swedish while offering a quick switch to English if they're in a hurry?

alt.en: That came out fast! How do you politely explain your Swedish level and give them the choice?

alt.lit: I hold on to learn myself Swedish but am still fairly poor. If you not have hurry practise I gladly — have you hurry goes English much faster.
alt.en: I'm learning Swedish, though I'm still pretty bad at it. If you aren't in a hurry I'd love to practise — if you are, English will be much faster.

alt.sv: Förlåt att jag stakar mig, min svenska är väldigt begränsad. Vi kan ta det på svenska om du inte har bråttom, eller på engelska så går det snabbare.
alt.lit: Forgive that I stumble myself, my Swedish is very limited. We can take it in Swedish if you not have hurry, or in English so goes it faster.

alt.sv: Ursäkta, jag är nybörjare och min svenska är rätt skral. Jag behöver öva om det är lugnt för dig, men är du stressad och kan engelska tar vi det.
alt.lit: Excuse-me, I am beginner and my Swedish is rather poor. I need practise if it is calm for you, but are you stressed and know English take we that.
alt.en: Excuse me, I'm a beginner and my Swedish is pretty weak. I need to practise if you're not busy, though if you're rushed and speak English let's use that.

alt.sv: Jag pratar tyvärr jättedålig svenska än så länge. Har du en minut över övar jag gärna, men har du bråttom går engelska betydligt fortare.
alt.lit: I speak unfortunately super-poor Swedish still so long. Have you one minute over practise I gladly, but have you hurry goes English considerably faster.
alt.en: Unfortunately I speak terrible Swedish so far. If you've got a minute to spare I'd love to practise, though if you're in a rush English is way faster.

alt.sv: Ursäkta, jag kämpar fortfarande med svenskan. Om du inte har bråttom vill jag gärna träna, annars funkar engelska snabbare om du pratar det.
alt.lit: Excuse-me, I struggle still with Swedish-the. If you not have hurry want I gladly train, otherwise works English faster if you speak it.
alt.en: Sorry, I'm still struggling with Swedish. If you aren't in a hurry I'd really like to practise; otherwise English works faster if you speak it.

alt.sv: Ingen brådska alls! Vi tar det lugnt på svenska — jag pratar lite långsammare så får du öva.
alt.lit: No hurry at-all! We take it calmly in Swedish — I speak a-little slower so get you practise.

alt.en: No stress at all, I've got plenty of time! Great that you're working on your Swedish — let's stick to Swedish.

alt.en: Say, do you wash microfibre mop heads at forty or sixty degrees without softener?

alt.en: Hi! Good feeling getting the machines spinning — just the 'joy' of vacuuming upstairs left now, eh?

alt.en: Your wife quietly whispers that you don't have to pretend you understood when someone speaks at a hundred miles an hour.

alt.en: Your wife gives you an encouraging nod: just be upfront about your Swedish and ask whether they have time or are in a rush.

alt.lit: Beside you smiles your wife and waits patiently on that you shall take word-the yourself.
alt.en: Beside you, your wife smiles and waits patiently for you to handle the explanation yourself.

alt.lit: Your wife nudges lightly on your arm: say as it is, people appreciate when one asks if they have hurry.
alt.en: Your wife nudges your arm gently: tell them straight — people appreciate being asked whether they're in a rush.

alt.en: How do you explain that your Swedish is poor, that you need to practise if they aren't rushed, or offer English if they are?

alt.en: What do you say to warn them about your Swedish and check whether there's time to practise or if English will be faster?

alt.lit: How ask you about to get practise Swedish — with an emergency-exit to English if person-the has hurry?
alt.en: How do you ask to practise your Swedish while offering a quick switch to English if they're in a hurry?

alt.sv: Nu gick det undan! Hur sätter du förväntningarna på svenskan på ett artigt sätt?
alt.lit: Now went it fast! How set you expectations-the on Swedish-the in a polite way?
alt.en: That came out fast! How do you politely explain your Swedish level and give them the choice?

alt.sv: Förlåt, mitt ordförråd på svenska är väldigt litet än. Jag måste öva om du har tålamod, men har du bråttom och kan engelska går det fortare.
alt.lit: Forgive, my vocabulary in Swedish is very small still. I must practise if you have patience, but have you hurry and know English goes it faster.
alt.en: Sorry, my Swedish vocabulary is tiny. I need to practise if you've got patience, though if you're in a hurry and speak English that'll be quicker.

alt.sv: Jag är tyvärr urusel på svenska fortfarande. Om du inte har bråttom provar jag gärna på svenska, men säg bara till om engelska går snabbare för dig.
alt.lit: I am unfortunately awful at Swedish still. If you not have hurry try I gladly in Swedish, but say just to if English goes faster for you.
alt.en: I'm still hopeless at Swedish, I'm afraid. If you aren't rushed I'd like to try in Swedish — otherwise just say the word if English is faster for you.

alt.sv: Varning för väldigt knackig svenska! Jag behöver öva om du inte är stressad, men har du bråttom och kan engelska så kör vi engelska.
alt.lit: Warning for very bumpy Swedish! I need practise if you not are stressed, but have you hurry and know English so run we English.
alt.en: Fair warning: very shaky Swedish ahead! I need to practise if you're not rushed, though if you're in a hurry and speak English let's do English.

alt.sv: Ursäkta, jag förstår bara lite svenska än. Om du inte har bråttom tränar jag gärna med dig, men kan du engelska går det fortare om du har bråttom.

alt.sv: Förlåt om jag pratar som en kråka, min svenska är inte bra än. Har du tid övar jag gärna, men har du bråttom tar vi engelska om det går bra.
alt.lit: Forgive if I speak like a crow, my Swedish is not good still. Have you time practise I gladly, but have you hurry take we English if it goes well.
alt.en: Sorry for butchering the language — my Swedish isn't good yet. If you've got time I'd love to practise; if you're in a hurry, let's switch to English.

alt.sv: Haha, ingen fara! Vi provar på långsam svenska först, och kör vi fast byter vi bara till engelska.
alt.lit: Haha, no danger! We try in slow Swedish first, and drive we stuck switch we just to English.
alt.en: Haha, don't worry! Let's try in slow Swedish first, and if we get stuck we'll just switch to English.

alt.sv: Jag har några minuter över! Vi kör enkel svenska så långt det går och fyller i med engelska vid behov.
alt.lit: I have a-few minutes over! We run simple Swedish as far it goes and fill in with English at need.
alt.en: I've got a few minutes! Let's go with simple Swedish as far as we get and fill in any gaps in English.

alt.sv: Vilken bra inställning! Jag sänker tempot till halvfart på svenska, och blir det krångligt kan jag engelska också.
alt.lit: What good attitude! I lower tempo-the to half-speed in Swedish, and becomes it tricky know I English too.
alt.en: Love that attitude! I'll drop to half-speed Swedish, and if things get tangled I speak English too.

alt.sv: Ingen panik! Vi blandar svenska och engelska om det behövs — huvudsaken är att du vågar prata.
alt.lit: No panic! We mix Swedish and English if it is-needed — main-thing-the is that you dare speak.
alt.en: No panic! We can mix Swedish and English if needed — the main thing is that you dare to speak.

alt.sv: Jag nickar febrilt och säger ja absolut till precis allt!
alt.lit: I nod feverishly and say yes absolutely to exact everything!
alt.en: I nod frantically and say 'Yes, absolutely!' to everything!

alt.sv: Jag ler stort och svarar jajemän utan att ha fattat ett enda ord.
alt.lit: I smile big and answer yeppers without to have grasped one single word.
alt.en: I beam widely and say 'You bet!' without having understood a single word.

alt.sv: Grattis, jag tror du precis lovade att passa en främlings hund hela julen.
alt.lit: Congratulations, I think you just promised to mind a stranger's dog whole Christmas-the.
alt.en: Congratulations, I'm pretty sure you just agreed to dog-sit for a stranger over Christmas.

alt.sv: Farlig strategi! Man kan inte säga jajemän till öppna frågor i Sverige.
alt.lit: Dangerous strategy! One can not say yeppers to open questions in Sweden.
alt.en: Dangerous tactic! You can't answer 'You bet!' to an either/or question in Sweden.

alt.sv: Jag fryser till is som en trädgårdstomte och stirrar rakt fram.
alt.lit: I freeze to ice like a garden-gnome and stare straight ahead.
alt.en: I freeze solid like a garden gnome and stare into the middle distance.

alt.sv: Jag står blickstilla och hoppas att jag smälter in i bakgrunden.
alt.lit: I stand dead-still and hope that I blend into background-the.
alt.en: I stand completely motionless and hope I blend into the scenery.

alt.sv: Blinka åtminstone så stackaren inte ringer ambulans!
alt.lit: Blink at-least so poor-person-the not phones ambulance!
alt.en: At least blink so the poor person doesn't call an ambulance!

alt.sv: Du har en knallfärgad jacka på dig, du är tyvärr inte osynlig.
alt.lit: You have a bright-coloured jacket on yourself, you are unfortunately not invisible.
alt.en: You're wearing a coat, not an invisibility cloak. Use your words!

alt.sv: Jag börjar prata jättehögt på engelska utan att fråga först.
alt.lit: I begin speak super-loudly in English without to ask first.
alt.en: I immediately start speaking English at double volume without asking first.

alt.sv: Jag ropar DO YOU SPEAK ENGLISH rakt ut i luften.
alt.lit: I shout DO YOU SPEAK ENGLISH straight out into air-the.
alt.en: I blurt out 'DO YOU SPEAK ENGLISH?!' at top volume.

alt.sv: Hela poängen i dag är ju att börja på svenska och fråga snällt!
alt.lit: Whole point-the today is after-all to begin in Swedish and ask kindly!
alt.en: The whole point today is starting politely in Swedish and giving them the option!

alt.sv: Sänk volymen och ta förklaringen på svenska först — du kan ju den!
alt.lit: Lower volume-the and take explanation-the in Swedish first — you know after-all it!
alt.en: Indoor voice, love — deliver your Swedish opener first, you've got this!

line.sv: Uppe i lägenheten är ni båda svettiga, hungriga och trötta. I ett ögonblick av total hjärnsläpp börjar du svabba hallgolvet med blöt mopp och såpa INNAN någon har dammsugit upp gruset.
line.lit: Up in flat-the are you both sweaty, hungry and tired. In a moment of total brain-slippage begin you swab hallway-floor-the with wet mop and soft-soap BEFORE anyone has vacuumed up grit-the.
line.en: Back upstairs, you are both sweaty, hungry, and fed up. In a moment of total brain fog, you start mopping the hallway floor with pine soap BEFORE vacuuming up the gravel.

line.sv: Men driver du med mig eller?! Man dammsuger väl INNAN man moppar! Nu har du ju smetat ut vått grus över hela hallen och mina rena strumpor är dyngsura!
line.lit: But kid you with me or?! One vacuums surely BEFORE one mops! Now have you after-all smeared out wet grit over whole hallway-the and my clean socks are soaking-wet!
line.en: Are you actually kidding me?! You vacuum BEFORE you mop! Now you've smeared wet grit across the entire hall and my clean socks are sopping wet!

question.sv: Du tappar också humöret när hon fräser åt dig. Vad ryter du tillbaka innan det spårar ur helt?
question.lit: You lose also temper-the when she hisses at you. What roar you back before it derails out completely?
question.en: Your temper flares right back. What do you snap before things go completely nuclear?

say.sv: Förlåt att jag inte har doktorerat i golvvård då! Sluta skälla på mig i två sekunder så torkar jag upp gruset och dammsuger!
say.lit: Sorry that I not have earned-a-doctorate in floor-care then! Stop bark on me in two seconds so wipe I up grit-the and vacuum!
say.en: Well excuse me for not holding a PhD in floor care! Stop yelling at me for two seconds and I'll wipe up the grit and vacuum!

reply.sv: Jag skäller inte, jag pratar bara väldigt tydligt! Ställ ner den där förbannade moppen innan jag kastar ut den från balkongen!
reply.lit: I bark not, I speak just very clearly! Set down that there damned mop-the before I throw out it from balcony-the!
reply.en: I'm not yelling, I'm just enunciating very loudly! Put that bloody mop down before I throw it off the balcony!

say.sv: Då får väl ers kungliga höghet moppa resten av slottet helt själv!
say.lit: Then gets surely your royal highness mop rest-the of castle-the wholly self!
say.en: Then Your Royal Highness can mop the rest of the palace all by herself!

reply.sv: Kalla mig ers höghet en gång till så sover du på dörrmattan i natt! Försök igen utan att vara så odräglig.

reply.en: Call me Your Highness one more time and you're sleeping on the doormat tonight! Try again without being quite that insufferable.

say.en: I'll dump the whole mop bucket onto the parquet so we don't have to argue over details.

reply.sv: Våga inte ens titta på hinken! Ta ett djupt andetag nu.

reply.en: Don't even look at that bucket! Take a deep breath right now.

say.sv: Grus på golvet ger faktiskt rustik skandinavisk karaktär åt hemmet.

say.en: Wet gravel on the floor actually gives the flat a rustic Scandinavian texture.

reply.en: This isn't an interior design magazine — my toes are covered in wet grit and pine soap!

line.en: I'm terribly sorry for happening to mention that dirt + water equals mud. I shall strive immediately to become a quieter, more grateful human being.

question.sv: Hon försöker se sur ut men hennes mungipa rycker till. Hur svarar du så att isen smälter?
question.lit: She tries look grumpy out but her mouth-corner twitches to. How answer you so that ice-the melts?
question.en: She's trying to keep a straight, furious face, but the corner of her mouth twitches. How do you answer to break the ice?

say.sv: Och jag ber ödmjukast om ursäkt för mitt golvbrott — förlåt på riktigt älskling, jag var hungrig och grinig.

say.en: And I most humbly apologise for my crimes against flooring — truly sorry, love, I was hangry and irritable.

reply.sv: Förlåt själv för att jag skrek som en fiskmås. Kom hit och ge mig en kram... fast vänta, fem minuter kvar på tvättiden! Spring!
reply.lit: Sorry self for that I screamed like a seagull. Come here and give me a hug... though wait, five minutes left on laundry-time-the! Run!
reply.en: Sorry too for screeching like a seagull. Come here and hug me... wait, five minutes left on our laundry slot! Run!

say.sv: Tack, det var väldigt stort av dig att äntligen erkänna dina brister.
say.lit: Thanks, it was very big of you to finally admit your shortcomings.
say.en: Thank you, that was very big of you to finally acknowledge your flaws.

reply.sv: Åh, du var SÅ nära att överleva den här lördagen! Gör ett nytt försök.
reply.lit: Oh, you were SO close to survive this here Saturday-the! Make a new try.
reply.en: Oh, you were SO close to surviving this Saturday! Try that again.

say.sv: Jag förlåter dig, trots att mina känslor fick en rejäl vattenskada.
say.lit: I forgive you, despite that my feelings got a proper water-damage.
say.en: I forgive you, even though my feelings suffered severe water damage.

reply.sv: Dina känslor klarar lite grönsåpa. Säg förlåt utan teater nu.

reply.en: Your feelings can handle a little pine soap. Apologise without the theatrics.

say.sv: Jag tänker sura tyst i hallen resten av helgen av ren princip.
say.lit: I intend sulk silently in hallway-the rest-the of weekend-the out-of pure principle.
say.en: I plan on sulking silently in the hallway all weekend out of pure principle.

reply.sv: Stå inte på det nymoppade golvet om du ska sura! Kom igen nu.
reply.lit: Stand not on the newly-mopped floor-the if you shall sulk! Come again now.
reply.en: Don't stand on the freshly mopped floor if you're going to sulk! Come on now.

title.sv: Luddfilter ett och två mot klockan
title.lit: Lint-filter one and two against clock-the
title.en: Lint filters one and two against the clock

line.sv: Ni rusar ner i källaren. Dinosaurieskärmen blinkar 00:04 KVAR innan strömmen klipps, och utanför glasdörren står nästa granne med armarna i kors. Skyltarna kräver: Rengör filter 1 OCH 2 i torktumlaren, gör rent tvättmedelsfacket, lämna luckan öppen och torka av maskiner och golv.
line.lit: You-two rush down into basement-the. Dinosaur-screen-the flashes 00:04 LEFT before power-the is-cut, and outside glass-door-the stands next neighbour with arms-the in cross. Signs-the demand: Clean filter 1 AND 2 in tumble-dryer-the, make clean detergent-compartment-the, leave hatch-the open and wipe off machines and floor.
line.en: You race down to the basement. The dinosaur LCD flashes '00:04 LEFT' before power cutoff, and outside the glass door stands the next neighbour with folded arms. The placards demand: clean filters 1 AND 2 in the dryer, rinse the detergent drawer, leave doors ajar, and wipe the machines and floor.

line.sv: Ursäkta, men mitt pass börjar prick hel. Ni har väl inte glömt det undre luddfiltret och att sopa golvet?
line.lit: Excuse-me, but my slot begins dot whole-hour. You have surely not forgotten the lower lint-filter-the and to sweep floor-the?
line.en: Excuse me, my slot starts right on the hour. You haven't forgotten the lower lint filter and sweeping the floor, have you?

question.sv: Tiden rinner ut! Hur lämnar du tvättstugan fläckfri innan låset slår igen?
question.lit: Time-the runs out! How leave you laundry-room-the spotless before lock-the slams shut?
question.en: Seconds are ticking away! How do you leave the laundry room spotless before the lock slams shut?

say.sv: Jag rensar både filter ett och två, sköljer tvättmedelsfacket, lämnar luckorna öppna och torkar av bänkar och golv.

say.en: I clean both lint filters one and two, rinse the detergent drawer, leave the doors and lid open, and wipe down the benches and floor.

reply.sv: Varsågod grannen, kirurgiskt rent med fyrtio sekunder till godo! Hjälp mig bära upp de varma lakanen nu.
reply.lit: There-you-go neighbour-the, surgically clean with forty seconds to good! Help me carry up the warm sheets-the now.
reply.en: All yours, neighbour — surgically spotless with forty seconds to spare! Help me carry these warm sheets upstairs now.

say.sv: Jag tar bara tvätten och springer, ludd är faktiskt gratis isolering.
say.lit: I take only laundry-the and run, lint is actually free insulation.
say.en: I just grab the laundry and bolt — lint is basically free insulation.

reply.sv: Aldrig i livet! Glömmer vi luddfilter två hamnar vi på en arg lapp i trapphuset i morgon bitti.
reply.lit: Never in life-the! Forget we lint-filter two end-up we on an angry note in stairwell-the tomorrow morning.
reply.en: Over my dead body! Skip filter two and we'll be shamed on an angry note in the stairwell tomorrow morning.

say.sv: Jag stänger alla luckor stenhårt så maskinerna ser prydliga ut.

say.en: I slam every washer door and detergent lid shut so the machines look tidy.

reply.sv: Nej! Skylten säger ju Lämna dörrluckan öppen och låt locket till tvättmedelslådan vara öppen, annars möglar det!

reply.en: No! The sign explicitly says leave the drum door and detergent lid open, otherwise they go mouldy!

say.sv: Jag ber grannen städa klart åt oss som en trevlig helgaktivitet.

say.en: I invite the neighbour to finish cleaning up for us as a fun weekend activity.

reply.sv: Titta på grannens blick. Vill du bo kvar i den här kommunen gör vi rent filtren nu.
reply.lit: Look on neighbour-the's gaze. Want you live left in this here municipality-the make we clean filters-the now.
reply.en: Look at the neighbour's eyes. If you want to carry on living in this municipality, clean those filters now.

line.sv: Hemma doftar hela lägenheten grönsåpa och nytvättat. Disken är borta, golven glänser och ni slänger de varma lakanen på sängen. Din fru drar tröjan över huvudet, kliver upp i sängen och ger dig en retsam blick.
