line.en: Upstairs, the entire flat smells of fresh pine soap and clean linen. The dishes are done, the floors gleam, and you toss the warm sheets onto the bed. Your wife pulls her top over her head, climbs onto the mattress, and gives you a wicked grin.

line.sv: Vet du vad det absolut bästa med att skrika sig hes över en golvmopp och bädda med varma lakan är? Att vi äntligen kan skrynkla till hela sängen igen. Lås sovrumsdörren och kom hit.
line.lit: Know you what the absolutely best with to shout oneself hoarse over a floor-mop and make-bed with warm sheets is? That we finally can rumple to whole bed-the again. Lock bedroom-door-the and come here.
line.en: Do you know what the absolute best part of shouting ourselves hoarse over a mop and putting warm sheets on the bed is? Getting to rumple the whole bed all over again. Lock the bedroom door and get over here.

question.sv: Hon sträcker ut handen och drar dig i linningen. Vad svarar du?
question.lit: She reaches out hand-the and pulls you in waistband-the. What answer you?
question.en: She reaches out and tugs you by the waistband. What do you say?

say.sv: Lägenheten skiner, luddfiltret är rent och jag tänker inte vika ett enda plagg till — kom hit.
say.lit: Flat-the shines, lint-filter-the is clean and I intend not fold one single garment more — come here.
say.en: The flat is spotless, the lint filter is clean, and I'm not folding one more item of clothing — come here.

reply.sv: Nu pratar du äntligen flytande svenska. Glöm tvättkorgen, den kan vänta till i morgon.
reply.lit: Now speak you finally fluent Swedish. Forget laundry-basket-the, it can wait until tomorrow.
reply.en: Now you're finally speaking fluent Swedish. Forget the laundry basket — it can wait till tomorrow.

say.sv: Vänta, borde vi inte sortera alla mikrofiberdukar efter färg först?
say.lit: Wait, ought we not sort all microfibre-cloths after colour first?
say.en: Hold on, shouldn't we colour-code all the microfibre cloths first?

reply.sv: Säger du ordet mikrofiberduk en enda gång till får du sova nere i torkskåpet!
reply.lit: Say you word-the microfibre-cloth one single time more get you sleep down in drying-cabinet-the!
reply.en: Say the word 'microfibre cloth' one more time and you're sleeping downstairs in the drying cabinet!

say.sv: Behöver jag hålla plastbrickan mot sänggaveln för att boka trettio minuter?
say.lit: Need I hold plastic-tag-the against headboard-the for to book thirty minutes?
say.en: Do I need to tap the plastic laundry tag against the headboard to book a slot?

reply.sv: Ingen plastbricka behövs, men kommer du inte hit inom fem sekunder förlorar du bokningen!
reply.lit: No plastic-tag is-needed, but come you not here within five seconds lose you booking-the!
reply.en: No plastic tag required, though if you're not in this bed within five seconds your booking is cancelled!

say.sv: Akta så vi inte skrynklar lakanen, anti-skrynklingsfunktionen är avstängd!
say.lit: Watch-out so we not crease sheets-the, anti-crease-function-the is switched-off!
say.en: Careful we don't crease the sheets — the anti-crease function is off!

reply.sv: Hela poängen just nu är maximal skrynklighet. Sluta prata om Electrolux och kyss mig.
reply.lit: Whole point-the right now is maximum creasiness. Stop talk about Electrolux and kiss me.
reply.en: Maximum creasing is the entire point right now. Stop talking about Electrolux and kiss me.

line.sv: En timme senare smattrar regnet mot fönstret. Lakanen är totalt tillskrynklade, pulsen har sjunkit och ingen bryr sig det minsta om de ovikta handdukarna på stolen.
line.lit: One hour later patters rain-the against window-the. Sheets-the are totally rumpled, pulse-the has sunk and nobody cares itself the slightest about the unfolded towels-the on chair-the.
line.en: An hour later, rain patters against the bedroom window. The clean sheets are thoroughly rumpled, your pulse has finally slowed, and neither of you cares one bit about the unfolded towels on the chair.

line.sv: Okej, jag erkänner. Om städdagar slutar så här kanske vi borde boka tvättstugan lite oftare — fast nästa gång dammsuger du först.
line.lit: Okay, I admit. If cleaning-days end like here maybe we ought book laundry-room-the a-little more-often — though next time vacuum you first.
line.en: All right, I'll admit it. If cleaning days end like this, maybe we should book the laundry room more often — though next time, you're vacuuming first.

question.sv: Vad säger du där ni ligger under täcket?
question.lit: What say you there you-two lie under duvet-the?
question.en: What do you say lying together under the duvet?

say.sv: Deal. Ligg kvar här så hämtar jag kaffe i två garanterat rena koppar.
say.lit: Deal. Lie remaining here so fetch I coffee in two guaranteedly clean cups.
say.en: Deal. Stay right there and I'll bring us coffee in two guaranteed-clean mugs.

reply.sv: Älskar dig. Och spill inte i sängen nu, för bokningsdinosaurien släpper inte in oss förrän nästa vecka!
reply.lit: Love you. And spill not in bed-the now, for booking-dinosaur-the lets not in us until next week!
reply.en: Love you. And don't spill a drop on the bed — the booking dinosaur won't let us back into the laundry room until next week!

say.sv: Ska vi gå ner och rengöra grannens luddfilter en gång till?
say.lit: Shall we go down and clean neighbour-the's lint-filter one time more?
say.en: Want to head back downstairs and clean the neighbour's lint filter one more time?

reply.sv: Nämner du luddfiltret i den här sängen kastar jag kudden på dig.
reply.lit: Mention you lint-filter-the in this here bed-the throw I pillow-the on you.
reply.en: Mention lint filters in this bed again and you're getting hit with a pillow.

say.sv: Jag funderar på att moppa sovrumstaket när jag ändå är varm i kläderna.
say.lit: I ponder on to mop bedroom-ceiling-the when I anyway am warm in clothes-the.
say.en: I'm thinking of mopping the bedroom ceiling while I'm warmed up.

reply.sv: Du har inga kläder på dig, älskling. Gå och hämta kaffet bara.
reply.lit: You have no clothes on you, darling. Go and fetch coffee-the just.
reply.en: You're not wearing any clothes, darling. Just go fetch the coffee.

say.sv: Jag ger dagens tvättpass fem av fem brontosaurier.
say.lit: I give day-the's laundry-slot five of five brontosauruses.
say.en: I give today's laundry slot five out of five brontosauruses.

reply.sv: Och du får fem av fem för avslutningen. Hämta kaffet nu.
reply.lit: And you get five of five for ending-the. Fetch coffee-the now.
reply.en: And you get five out of five for the finale. Go get that coffee.

line.sv: Efter utflykten står ni vid ytterdörren igen. Du känner efter i fickorna.
line.lit: After outing-the stand you [plural] at outer-door-the again. You feel around in pockets-the.
line.en: After the outing you're at the front door again. You check your pockets.

line.sv: Nycklarna lade du i jackfickan innan vi gick.
line.lit: Keys-the laid you in jacket-pocket-the before we went.
line.en: You put the keys in your jacket pocket before we left.

question.sv: Vad säger du när du hittar dem?
question.lit: What say you when you find them?
question.en: What do you say when you find them?

say.sv: Här är nycklarna. Jag låser upp.
say.lit: Here are keys-the. I unlock up.
say.en: Here are the keys. I'll unlock the door.

reply.sv: Skönt. Huset står kvar och vi kommer in också.
reply.lit: Lovely. House-the stands still and we come in too.
reply.en: Lovely. The house is still here, and we can get inside too.

say.sv: Jag tror att dörren behöver en biljett.
say.lit: I think that door-the needs a ticket.
say.en: I think the door needs a ticket.

reply.sv: Den har redan en egen plats.
reply.lit: It has already its own place.
reply.en: It already has a place of its own.

say.sv: Vi väntar på nästa ersättningsdörr.
say.lit: We wait for next replacement-door.
say.en: Let's wait for the next replacement door.

reply.sv: Den här verkar gå enligt tidtabell.
reply.lit: This here seems to go according to timetable.
reply.en: This one seems to be running on time.

say.sv: Nycklar är nog bara en rekommendation.
say.lit: Keys are probably only a recommendation.
say.en: Keys are probably just a recommendation.

reply.sv: Låset har ganska bestämda åsikter om det.
reply.lit: Lock-the has fairly firm opinions about it.
reply.en: The lock has rather firm opinions about that.

line.sv: Ni kliver in genom ytterdörren med fuktiga skor och lite grus under sulorna. Hallgolvet bortom mattan är torrt och rent.
line.lit: You-two step in through outer-door-the with damp shoes and a-little grit under soles-the. Hallway-floor-the beyond mat-the is dry and clean.
line.en: You step inside the front door with damp shoes and street grit on your soles. Beyond the doormat, the hallway floor is clean and dry.

line.sv: Ett enda blött fotspår på parketten och du vet vem som får hämta skurtrasan!
line.lit: One single wet footprint on parquet-the and you know who that gets fetch floor-cloth-the!
line.en: Put one wet footprint on the parquet and you know who's fetching the floor cloth!

question.sv: Hur tar du dig in utan att dra in halva gatan?
question.lit: How take you yourself in without to drag in half street-the?
question.en: How do you come inside without tracking half the street in with you?

say.sv: Jag stannar på dörrmattan, knyter upp skorna och ställer dem på skohyllan.
say.lit: I stay on doormat-the, untie up shoes-the and place them on shoe-rack-the.
say.en: I stay strictly on the doormat, unlace my shoes, and set them on the shoe tray.

reply.sv: Föredömligt! Parketten och vårt kvällslugn är räddade.
reply.lit: Exemplary! Parquet-the and our evening-calm are saved.
reply.en: Exemplary! Both the parquet and our peaceful evening are saved.

say.sv: Jag går på händerna in i vardagsrummet så skorna hålls i luften.
say.lit: I walk on hands-the into living-room-the so shoes-the are-kept in air-the.
say.en: I'll handstand-walk into the living room to keep my soles off the floor.

reply.sv: Imponerande gymnastik, men du kommer riva ner alla jackor på vägen.
reply.lit: Impressive gymnastics, but you will tear down all jackets on way-the.
reply.en: Impressive gymnastics, though you'll bring the entire coat rack down on top of us.

say.sv: Jag sparkar av mig skorna så de flyger rakt in i köket.
say.lit: I kick off myself shoes-the so they fly straight into kitchen-the.
say.en: I kick my shoes off at high velocity straight down the corridor.

reply.sv: Inga flygande skor i min lägenhet, tack!
reply.lit: No flying shoes in my flat, thanks!
reply.en: Zero airborne footwear indoors, thank you!

say.sv: Jag åker skridskor på två grytlappar genom hallen.
say.lit: I skate ice-skates on two potholders through hallway-the.
say.en: I'll skate down the hall standing on two oven mitts.

reply.sv: Knyt bara upp skosnörena som en vanlig människa.
reply.lit: Untie just up shoelaces-the like a normal human.
reply.en: Just untie your laces like a normal person.

title.en: The mail drift inside the door

line.sv: När ni öppnar ytterdörren skrapar dörren mot en hög av reklamblad, ett fönsterkuvert och en paketavi på hallmattan.
line.lit: When you-two open outer-door-the scrapes door-the against a pile of advertising-leaflets, a window-envelope and a parcel-slip on hallway-mat-the.
line.en: As you push the front door open, it scrapes across a drift of junk mail, a window envelope, and a parcel slip on the mat.

line.sv: Akta så du inte åker kana på pizzerians reklamblad!
line.lit: Watch-out so you not slide sled on pizzeria-the's flyer!
line.en: Careful you don't go skiing across the hall on the local pizzeria menu!

question.sv: Vad gör du med skörden från brevinkastet?
question.lit: What do you with harvest-the from letterbox-the?
question.en: What do you do with today's haul from the letterbox?

say.sv: Jag plockar upp posten, sorterar bort reklamen och lägger breven på hallbyrån.
say.lit: I pick up post-the, sort away advertising-the and lay letters-the on hallway-chest-the.
say.en: I scoop up the mail, toss the flyers in the paper recycling, and put the real letters on the hall table.

reply.sv: Skönt! Och paketavin kan lugnt vänta tills i morgon.
reply.lit: Lovely! And parcel-slip-the can calmly wait until tomorrow.
reply.en: Nice! And whatever's on that parcel slip can wait till tomorrow.

say.sv: Jag trycker ut all reklam tillbaka genom brevinkastet i trapphuset.
say.lit: I push out all advertising back through letterbox-the in stairwell-the.
say.en: I shove all the flyers back out through the letterbox onto the stairwell landing.

reply.sv: Så gör man sig väldigt snabbt ovän med både brevbäraren och grannarna.
reply.lit: So makes one oneself very quickly enemy with both postman-the and neighbours-the.
reply.en: Fastest way in Sweden to make enemies of both the postie and the whole building.

say.sv: Jag strimlar kuverten utan att öppna dem först.
say.lit: I shred envelopes-the without to open them first.
say.en: I'll shred the window envelope unread so the bill ceases to exist.

reply.sv: Fönsterkuvert brukar tyvärr ha väldigt gott minne även i bitar.
reply.lit: Window-envelopes tend-to unfortunately have very good memory even in pieces.
reply.en: Sadly, bills have an elephant's memory even after shredding.

say.sv: Jag lägger mig raklång på hallmattan med reklambladen som täcke.
say.lit: I lay myself flat-out on hallway-mat-the with flyers-the as duvet.
say.en: I lie flat out on the doormat using the supermarket flyers as a blanket.

reply.sv: Soffan inne i vardagsrummet är betydligt mjukare än extrapris på falukorv.
reply.lit: Sofa-the inside in living-room-the is considerably softer than special-price on falu-sausage.
reply.en: The living-room sofa is much softer than a two-for-one sausage circular.

title.en: No spare hands at the front door

line.sv: Framme vid lägenhetsdörren har du händerna fulla av kassar, blöta vantar och halsduk medan nyckelknippan dinglar från ditt lillfinger.
line.lit: Arrived by flat-door-the have you hands-the full of bags, wet mittens and scarf while key-bunch-the dangles from your little-finger.
line.en: At your flat door your hands are loaded with bags, damp gloves, and scarves while the keyring dangles precariously from your pinky.

line.sv: Du ser ut som en jonglör på cirkus. Försök inte vrida om låset med armbågen nu.
line.lit: You look out like a juggler at circus. Try not turn about lock-the with elbow-the now.
line.en: You look like a circus juggler. Please don't try turning the deadbolt with your elbow.

question.sv: Vad säger du för att komma in utan att tappa allt i trappan?
question.lit: What say you for to come in without to drop everything on stairs-the?
question.en: What do you say so you get inside without dropping everything down the stairs?

say.sv: Kan du hålla mina kassar en sekund så jag kan låsa upp dörren?
say.lit: Can you hold my bags one second so I can unlock up door-the?
say.en: Could you hold these bags for a second so I can unlock the door properly?

reply.sv: Självklart! Lagspel fungerar mycket bättre än akrobatik.
reply.lit: Of-course! Team-play works much better than acrobatics.
reply.en: Of course! Teamwork beats hallway acrobatics every time.

say.sv: Jag biter tag i nyckeln med tänderna och vrider runt huvudet.
say.lit: I bite hold in key-the with teeth-the and twist around head-the.
say.en: I'll grip the house key between my teeth and rotate my entire head.

reply.sv: Tandläkaren är stängd på lördagar. Ge mig kassen bara.
reply.lit: Dentist-the is closed on Saturdays. Give me bag-the just.
reply.en: Emergency dentists cost a fortune on Saturdays. Just hand me the bag.

say.sv: Jag nickar till dörrklockan med pannan tills dörren öppnar sig.
say.lit: I headbutt to doorbell-the with forehead-the until door-the opens itself.
say.en: I'll press the doorbell with my forehead until the flat opens up.

reply.sv: Vi är båda på utsidan, älskling. Ingen är hemma och kan öppna.
reply.lit: We are both on outside-the, darling. Nobody is at-home and can open.
reply.en: We're both standing on the outside, love. Nobody's inside to answer it.

say.sv: Vi slår läger här på trappavsatsen för natten.
say.lit: We pitch camp here on stair-landing-the for night-the.
say.en: Let's just make camp right here on the landing for the night.

reply.sv: Trettio centimeter från vår egen säng? Aldrig.
reply.lit: Thirty centimetres from our own bed? Never.
reply.en: Twelve inches from our own warm flat? Not a chance.

line.sv: Precis utanför er dörr möter ni den trevliga grannen från våningen ovanför som bär ner tidningspapper.
line.lit: Just outside your door meet you-two the friendly neighbour-the from floor-the above who carries down newspaper-paper.
line.en: Right outside your door you bump into the friendly upstairs neighbour carrying down a stack of old newspapers.

line.sv: Hej på er! Jaha, ni har varit ute i ruskvädret! Det märks att det går mot kallare tider nu!
line.lit: Hi on you! Aha, you have been out in dreary-weather-the! It is-noticed that it goes towards colder times now!
line.en: Hello there! Out braving the weather, eh? You can really tell the chillier season's setting in now!

question.sv: Din fru knuffar lätt till dig med ett leende — svara på klassiskt svenskt trapphussnack!
question.lit: Your wife nudges lightly to you with a smile — answer on classic Swedish stairwell-chat!
question.en: Your wife gives you a gentle nudge — deliver a textbook Swedish stairwell reply!

say.sv: Ja verkligen, nu är det skönt att komma in i värmen! Trevlig helg!
say.lit: Yes really, now is it nice to come into warmth-the! Pleasant weekend!
say.en: It really is — lovely to get back indoors in the warmth now! Have a great weekend!

reply.sv: Tio poäng av tio i svensk grannsämja! In med oss nu.
reply.lit: Ten points of ten in Swedish neighbour-harmony! In with us now.
reply.en: Ten out of ten for Swedish neighbourliness! Let's get inside.

say.sv: Jag väser som en grävling och gömmer mig bakom krukväxten.
say.lit: I hiss like a badger and hide myself behind potted-plant-the.
say.en: I hiss like a cornered badger and crouch behind the stairwell fern.

reply.sv: Vi måste bo i det här huset även på måndag. Säg bara trevlig helg!
reply.lit: We must live in this here building-the even on Monday. Say just pleasant weekend!
reply.en: We still have to live in this building on Monday. Just wish them a nice weekend!

say.sv: Jag håller ett fyrtio minuter långt föredrag om lufttryck på engelska.
say.lit: I hold a forty minutes long lecture about air-pressure in English.
say.en: I launch into a forty-minute English lecture on barometric pressure.

reply.sv: Trapphussamtal får max vara åtta sekunder långa enligt oskriven lag.
reply.lit: Stairwell-conversations may max be eight seconds long according-to unwritten law.
reply.en: By unwritten Swedish law, stairwell small talk must never exceed eight seconds.

say.sv: Jag låtsas att vi har gått fel och går en trappa upp till vinden.
say.lit: I pretend that we have walked wrong and walk one flight up to attic-the.
say.en: I pretend we don't live here and keep walking all the way up to the attic.

reply.sv: Grannen vet mycket väl var vi bor. Hälsa fint och lås upp!
reply.lit: Neighbour-the knows very well where we live. Greet nicely and unlock up!
reply.en: They know perfectly well which door is ours. Say hello nicely and unlock the door!

line.sv: Ytterdörren slår igen bakom er och lägenhetsvärmen slår emot kinderna. Dina fingrar är kalla och jackan är fuktig i axlarna.
line.lit: Outer-door-the shuts again behind you and flat-warmth-the hits against cheeks-the. Your fingers are cold and jacket-the is damp in shoulders-the.
line.en: The front door clicks shut behind you and the warmth of the flat wraps around your cheeks. Your fingers are stiff and your coat shoulders are damp.

line.sv: Åh vad skönt att vara inne igen. Släng inte den blöta jackan i en hög på stolen bara.
line.lit: Oh how lovely to be inside again. Toss not the wet jacket-the in a pile on chair-the just.
line.en: Oh, it feels good to be back inside. Just don't dump your damp jacket in a heap on the chair.

question.sv: Vad gör du först när ni kommit hem?
question.lit: What do you first when you-two come home?
question.en: What's the first thing you do back inside?

say.sv: Jag hänger upp våra jackor på galgar så de torkar och tvättar händerna i varmvatten.
say.lit: I hang up our jackets on coat-hangers so they dry and wash hands-the in warm-water.
say.en: I hang both our coats on proper hangers to dry and warm my hands under hot tap water.

reply.sv: Underbart. Jag sätter på lite varmt att dricka åt oss under tiden.
reply.lit: Wonderful. I put on a-little warm to drink for us during time-the.
reply.en: Wonderful. I'll get hot drinks started while you warm up.

say.sv: Jag knölar ner den fuktiga jackan längst ner i byrålådan.
say.lit: I cram down the damp jacket-the farthest down in chest-drawer-the.
say.en: I'll stuff the wet coat into the bottom of a closed chest of drawers.

reply.sv: Om du inte gillar doften av gammal källare är galgen ett bättre val.
reply.lit: If you not like scent-the of old cellar is hanger-the a better choice.
reply.en: Unless you love the aroma of damp cellar, a coat hanger is the better move.

say.sv: Jag stoppar in mina kalla händer innanför din tröja på ryggen!
say.lit: I stick in my cold hands inside your jumper on back-the!
say.en: I shove my ice-cold hands straight up the back of your jumper!

reply.sv: VÅGA INTE! Tvättställets varmvattenkran är till höger!
reply.lit: DARE NOT! Washbasin-the's hot-water-tap is to right!
reply.en: DON'T YOU DARE! The bathroom hot tap is right over there!

say.sv: Jag behåller både regnjacka, mössa och skor på i soffan.
say.lit: I keep both rain-jacket, hat and shoes on in sofa-the.
say.en: I'll keep my wet coat, hat, and outdoor shoes on in the sofa.

reply.sv: Du bor här, du väntar inte på en nattbuss.
reply.lit: You live here, you wait not on a night-bus.
reply.en: You live here — you're not waiting at a rural bus shelter.

title.en: The hunt for the warm slippers

line.sv: Skorna är av och tårna längtar efter värme, men bara vänster toffel står vid skohyllan. Höger toffel sticker fram bakom paraplystället.
line.lit: Shoes-the are off and toes-the long after warmth, but only left slipper stands by shoe-rack-the. Right slipper pokes forth behind umbrella-stand-the.
line.en: Your shoes are off and your toes want warmth, but only your left slipper is by the rack; the right one is hiding behind the umbrella stand.

line.sv: Hur lyckas dina tofflor vandra runt i lägenheten på egen hand när vi inte ens är hemma?
line.lit: How succeed your slippers wander around in flat-the on own hand when we not even are at-home?
line.en: How do your slippers manage to migrate across the flat while nobody's even home?

question.sv: Vad säger du när du pustar ut i hallen?
question.lit: What say you when you breathe out in hallway-the?
question.en: What do you say as you exhale in the hallway?

say.sv: Äntligen hemma! Jag fiskar fram båda tofflorna och byter till mjukisbyxor.
say.lit: Finally at-home! I fish forth both slippers-the and change to sweatpants.
say.en: Home sweet home! I fish out both slippers and go change into joggers.

reply.sv: Mjukisbyxor är den officiella uniformen för lördag kväll.
reply.lit: Sweatpants are the official uniform-the for Saturday evening.
reply.en: Joggers are the official uniform of Saturday night.

say.sv: Jag sätter en tom mjölkkartong på högerfoten i stället.
say.lit: I put an empty milk-carton on right-foot-the instead.
say.en: I'll wear an empty milk carton on my right foot instead.

reply.sv: Den ligger ju precis bakom paraplystället, sträck bara ut handen!
reply.lit: It lies after-all right behind umbrella-stand-the, reach just out hand-the!
reply.en: It's literally six inches behind the umbrella stand — just reach over!

say.sv: Jag ställer mig ovanpå dina fötter så slipper jag kalla golv.
say.lit: I stand myself on-top-of your feet so escape I cold floors.
say.en: I'll stand on top of your feet and let you carry me to the sofa.

reply.sv: Mina fötter har gått precis lika långt som dina i dag.
reply.lit: My feet have walked exact equally far as yours today.
reply.en: My feet walked the exact same distance yours did today.

say.sv: Vi vänder i dörren och går ut en timme till.
say.lit: We turn in doorway-the and walk out one hour more.
say.en: Let's turn right around and go back out for another hour.

reply.sv: Ytterdörren är stängd för i dag, min vän.
reply.lit: Outer-door-the is closed for today, my friend.
reply.en: This front door is officially closed for business until Sunday.

line.sv: Du ställer ifrån dig väskan i hallen och sneglar längtansfullt mot soffan. Sätter ni er nu med jackorna halvt på kommer allt ligga kvar på golvet till måndag.
line.lit: You set away-from yourself bag-the in hallway-the and eye longingly towards sofa-the. Sit you-two yourselves now with jackets-the half on will everything lie remaining on floor-the until Monday.
line.en: You set the bag down in the hall and eye the sofa longingly. Both of you know that if you sit down right now, nothing gets put away before Monday.

line.sv: Jag ser hur soffan drar i dig som en magnet. Två minuters disciplin först, va?
line.lit: I see how sofa-the pulls in you like a magnet. Two minutes' discipline first, eh?
line.en: I can see the sofa pulling at you like a tractor beam. Two minutes of willpower first, deal?

question.sv: Vad svarar du innan ni kraschar för kvällen?
question.lit: What answer you before you-two crash for evening-the?
question.en: What do you say before collapsing for the evening?

say.sv: Du har rätt — vi packar ur väskan och hänger in allt direkt så kan vi slappa sen.
say.lit: You have right — we unpack out-of bag-the and hang in everything directly so can we relax later.
say.en: You're right — let's unpack the bag and hang everything up right now so we can properly relax.

reply.sv: Så ja! Sjuttio sekunder tog det, och nu tillhör soffan oss.
reply.lit: Like yes! Seventy seconds took it, and now belongs sofa-the to-us.
reply.en: Boom — seventy seconds flat, and now the sofa is all ours.

say.sv: Jag lägger mig på hallgolvet med ryggsäcken som huvudkudde.
